review.summary: The candidate implementation is a static documentation/marketing page instead of the full interactive live-room application shell. It completely lacks the top navigation bar, the left 'Room Binder' sidebar, the right 'Public chat' panel, and the bottom status bar present in the reference design.

differences.reference: Full interactive live-room application shell with a top bar, left 'Room Binder' sidebar, central workspace, right 'Public chat' panel, and bottom status bar.
differences.candidate: A static documentation/marketing page layout with a simple left navigation rail ('PRODUCT SURFACES') and a large header explaining the notebook feature.
differences.fix: Rebuild the entire application frame to include the top bar, left Room Binder, right chat panel, and bottom status bar as specified in the reference live-room design.

differences.reference: The 'needs review' badge in the claim box is positioned inline next to the claim text.
differences.candidate: The 'needs review' badge is positioned in the top-right corner of the claim box.
differences.fix: Move the 'needs review' badge inline next to the claim text to match the reference layout.

differences.reference: The notebook document is embedded inside a multi-pane layout with tight margins and a floating '+' icon next to the 'Funding' header.
differences.candidate: The notebook document is displayed in a wide, centered container with a red vertical line and drag handles on the left margin.
differences.fix: Adjust the notebook container width and margins to fit the central pane of the live-room shell, and remove the documentation-specific margin decorations.

keep: The warm cream background color of the notebook document.
The typography and styling of the 'CardioNova — diligence brief' title and tags.
The styling of the verified and conflict source pills.
